class.name: PlayerStart3D
class.brief_description: Where a player may appear in a 3D level.
class.description: The game mode hands one out per spawn and does not hand the same one out twice while it is claimed. [member player_start_tag] lets a level keep separate sets - one per team, or one for the start of a round - which [method GameModeBase.find_player_start] looks up by name.
